messages:
sam: saw a CI artifact alert in staging: a tarball contained `service-account.json` in `partner/fixtures/`. scanner flagged high. tagging sec+ops.
hema: can you paste the scanner id and a redacted snippet? need to know which SA and whether private_key present.
sam: scanner=artifact-scan-3 rule=sa-json-inline path=partner/fixtures/ingest.tar.gz file=partner/fixtures/service-account.json snippet: `{\n  \"type\": \"service_account\",\n  \"client_email\": \"partner-ingest@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com\",\n  \"private_key_id\": \"...\"\n}` (redacted)
drew: ok treat as compromised. immediate actions: revoke keys, generate new key, envelope-encrypt with KMS, store only ciphertext in Vault, and run org-wide artifact+repo sweep.
vault-bot: [Alert] repo/artifact-scan match=sa-json severity=high ticket=SEC-5010
hema: listing keys: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-staging --format=json` -> found key id `b3f0c1`. revoking now.
drew: revoke: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete b3f0c1 --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-staging` (done).
hema: creating replacement and wrapping with KMS. preferred flow (no plaintext stored):
```
# create new key to stdout and pipe to kms encrypt
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create - --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-staging | \
  gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=partner-keys --key=wrap-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- > newkey.json.enc
# store ciphertext in Vault
vault kv put secret/partner/ingest wrapped_ciphertext=@newkey.json.enc
```
sam: good. also add a temporary firewall to block any outgoing connections from the staging runner until we confirm no exfil. sec-oncall?
sec-oncall: monitoring enabled for staging egress and anomalous IPs. will escalate if spikes.
drew: we also need to harden KMS IAM: check for broad principals. run: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy wrap-key --keyring=partner-keys --location=global --project=redwood-kms` and remove any `allUsers`/external service accounts.
ops: found legacy binding `serviceAccount:legacy-deployer@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. removing now: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:legacy-deployer@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` (done).
hema: we should also add an automated rewrap helper so teams can migrate plaintext Vault entries safely: a small tool `kms-vault-rewrap` that will 1) pull plaintext secret, 2) encrypt with KMS, 3) write ciphertext back to Vault under `secret/<ns>/wrapped_ciphertext`, and 4) remove original plaintext. request ops to run it on legacy namespaces.
drew: agree. ops, can you run on `secret/legacy/*` with a dry-run first?
ops: scheduling OPS-1201 run for legacy rewrap dry-run (assigned infra-team).
vault-bot: [Task] created ticket SEC-5010-ops OPS-1201 for automated rewrap and audit enable.
hema: enable Vault audit on partner paths and set retention 365d: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/partner_ingest_audit.log` then ship to central logging.
sec-oncall: also add a Vault policy to deny writes that match SA JSON pattern. we can enforce at write-time: OPA rule + pre-commit hook for repos.
drew: detection regex for scanners and log processors: `(\\{\\s*\"type\"\\s*:\\s*\"service_account\\\"|\\\"private_key\"\\s*:)`. add to artifact scanner, repo scanner, and log-processor.
sam: compliance: do we need external notifications?
compliance: needs timeline and affected resource list. please post revoked key ids, artifact locations, and partner contact ack to SEC-5010. if partner key was used externally, we may need to notify; we'll advise after scope.
hema: post-incident checklist I'm adding to SEC-5010: 1) revoke exposed keys (done) 2) create new keys & envelope encrypt (done) 3) store ciphertext-only in Vault (done) 4) run org-wide artifact+repo sweep (in progress) 5) add pre-merge hooks + CI block on SA JSON (planned) 6) OPA/Terraform policy to forbid plaintext writes to Vault (planned) 7) schedule tabletop.
drew: timeline draft: detection 1977777777, revocation 1977779000, wrapped ciphertext stored 1977780500, partner ack expected 1977783000. attach to SEC-5010.
sam: thanks team. once OPS-1201 finishes dry-run, let's do a blacklist sweep and then run the automated rewrap. good catch. :thumbsup:
